newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris confirms lawsuit ruling.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris confirms lawsuit ruling.

text.p: Tobacco giant Philip Morris Cos Inc has confirmed a federal ruling dismissing a lawsuit brought by San Francisco and 11 other California counties against the company, a company statement said Thursday.

A federal judge in the District Court in the Northern District of California in Oakland dismissed the suit, saying it failed to meet the proximate cause requirement under the federal racketeering statute.
The city and counties filed the suit in an attempt to recoup Medicaid costs.

"The decision affirmed that these politically motivated lawsuits cannot succeed by ignoring established rules of law and procedure," read the statement. "As we have said all along, this suit and the so-called Medicaid reimbursement suits filed by attorneys general across the country are blatant attempts to ignore established law."
However, the judge ruled that the plaintiffs' lawyers could refile an amended complaint.
